name: Four Seasons Resort and Residences Red Sea at Shura Island
positioning: Newly opened, secluded beach resort on the eastern tip of Shura Island on Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coast, with six alcohol-free restaurants and lounges, three pools and a spa
best_for: Families who want a complimentary kids' program, a Teen Centre and a Marine Discovery Centre
Travelers who want snorkelling, diving and water sports from a beachfront resort

facts.text: The resort has 149 single-storey rooms and suites.
The resort is on the secluded eastern tip of Shura Island.
The resort is a 25-minute drive from the Red Sea International Airport.
The resort has six restaurants and lounges.
Sea Green is the resort's plant-forward restaurant.
Al Forn serves traditional Arabic dishes from Lebanon and Syria.
The resort has three outdoor pools.
The spa has eight treatment rooms.
The resort has a 24-hour Fitness Centre.
Four Seasons describes the resort as brand-new.

highlights.text: Kids For All Seasons is a complimentary program at the resort.
The resort has a Teen Centre.
The Marine Discovery Centre offers interactive learning about the Red Sea reef system.
The resort offers guided snorkelling and diving experiences.
The spa has a stone-clad hammam.
The resort is on an island powered entirely by renewable energy.

considerations.text: All of the resort's restaurants are alcohol-free.
The tennis and padel courts are listed as coming soon.
WhataHotel notes that off-resort activities and surrounding infrastructure are still emerging.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
